canonical_write_rules.legacy: legacy scheduler owns canonical state; v2 may not write canonical state
canonical_write_rules.v2_shadow: legacy scheduler owns canonical state; v2 writes isolated shadow artifacts only
canonical_write_rules.v2_canary: legacy scheduler owns canonical state except explicitly listed canary parents; v2 still writes isolated artifacts unless promoted
canonical_write_rules.v2_primary: v2 owns intent_family_v2 canonical execution; legacy becomes read-only fallback

internal_wiring.public_ports: no new public port for v2
internal_wiring.api: serve v2 status through the existing plane schedule API
internal_wiring.watch: watch reads the shared scheduler projection bundle; no independent status derivation
internal_wiring.web: web surfaces read the same projection bundle as watch
internal_wiring.mobile: mobile surfaces read the same projection bundle as watch
internal_wiring.watchdog: watchdog reads health and receipts; it must not directly mutate v2 scheduler truth
internal_wiring.healer: healer requests scheduler-owned work items instead of repairing v2 truth directly
internal_wiring.benchmark: governance/evidence/benchmarks/scheduler compares legacy and v2 snapshots plus synthetic stress fixtures

cutover_sequence: v2_canary for one small intent family
v2_canary for several concurrent intent families
production_gates: restart truth identical across watch, API, web, and mobile
closeout is the only promotion path
watchdog cannot mutate v2 scheduler truth
rollback to legacy is one ownership-mode change
